Jobs.//Enabled: The background scheduler: reminder rules, report export files, and clearing expired booking holds and idempotency keys. false switches every job off on this instance. Safe to leave on in several instances: each job claims its work in the database.

Webhooks.//TimeoutSeconds: One delivery attempt, connect to last byte (1 to 30). Webhook URLs must be https to a public address; private, link-local and metadata ranges are refused at send time.

DataProtection.//KeysDirectory: Where the keys that encrypt webhook secrets and provider credentials live. Set a persistent volume in production; empty uses the ASP.NET Core default, which a container loses on rebuild.

Assistant.//Provider: Empty switches the website assistant off. 'gemini' for Google's API, 'openai' for any OpenAI-format server: Ollama (BaseUrl http://localhost:11434/v1), vLLM, llama.cpp, LM Studio. Set ApiKey from the environment (Assistant__ApiKey), never here.

Email.//Host: Any SMTP server: Google Workspace (smtp.gmail.com), Amazon SES, Resend, SendGrid. Empty Host keeps sign-in and invitation emails in the log. Set Password from the environment (Messaging__Email__Password), never here.

Sms.//Provider: 'thaibulksms' sends one-time codes by SMS. Empty keeps them in the log. Set ApiSecret from the environment (Messaging__Sms__ApiSecret), never here.
